request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Make the brown boots, belt, gloves and bomb handle charcoal grey, so nothing is brown, and make his skin a clear yellow-olive green. Keep every other pixel, the red flying cap with round iron goggles, the red tunic, the round black bomb raised high with its small pale spark, pose, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
